scope: Synthetic metadata discovery with the durable writer held stopped. This is a queue-backpressure reproduction, not a filesystem throughput or UI rendering benchmark.

environment.optimization: -O, Swift 5 language mode, ORBIT_TESTING, assertions enabled

protocol.fixtures: Eight real directories, each with 128 empty source files. Each native child-listing callback is replaced by 20,000 synthetic file metadata records with unique names within that directory and 220-character suffixes.
protocol.writer: Never advanced; every run verified SQLite contained only its initialized root node.
protocol.stoppingRule: Finish discovery or observe for 2 seconds, then capture metrics and cancel. Old pending-byte limit prevents enqueueing the next batch even if current pendingBytes is below the limit.
protocol.timing: Starts after fixture and stage creation. Includes synthetic record generation and in-memory discovery ingestion. Excludes durable ingestion, publication, UI and real large-tree enumeration.
protocol.isolation: Fresh process and private empty cache per run. Builds and regression tests stopped during measurements.
protocol.memory: Pending-byte count is an estimate, not RSS. peakRSSBytes uses getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).

recoveryNote: Restored from the exact surviving metadata, protocol, source hashes and four samples in local session history after the project folder was deleted. The original validation tail was unavailable; it has not been reconstructed or presented as original output. Current verification is recorded with the parallel-discovery benchmark.
